# mistershell_metric_customizations (Resource)

Binds configuration of an existing backend-owned object. Create captures originals and applies only configured fields; destroy restores those originals and never deletes the object. Removing a field restores and releases it. Import explicitly adopts current readable configuration. One binding per object/configuration surface. configuration = { items = [{ tag_id, skip_collection, thresholds }] }. List order is priority; [] clears all rows. Parent must remain enabled for writes and restore. Thresholds must match the metric type; null thresholds cannot be changed to values when that would prevent restoration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_metric_customizations" "thresholds" {
  id = mistershell_metric_config.health.id
  configuration = {
    items = [{
      tag_id          = mistershell_tag.production.id
      skip_collection = false
      thresholds      = { warning_threshold = 80, critical_threshold = 95 }
    }]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration = { items = [{ tag_id, skip_collection, thresholds }] }. List order is priority; [] clears all rows. Parent must remain enabled for writes and restore. Thresholds must match the metric type; null thresholds cannot be changed to values when that would prevent restoration.
- `id` (String) Existing object ID, stable catalog key, or local. This binding never creates the backend object.

### Read-Only

- `original_configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Original owned configuration retained in state for restoration. Do not edit; protect Terraform state.
